description: Change an auto-reply's keywords, exclusions, texts and variants, link, mode or post, pause it (live: false) or remove it (archived: true). Lists replace the old ones whole. Answers already waiting keep the text they were made with.

answer_earlier.description: Also answer comments from the last 7 days made before the rule existed, once each (false: only comments from now on)

dm.description: Instagram only: a private reply sent as a DM, once per comment, within 7 days of it. Good for links and discount codes. Say it's automated and how to opt out, e.g. end with "Automated message · reply STOP to stop, HUMAN for a person"; {name} becomes the commenter's username, {link} the rule's link (link_id), {products} the commented post's products (its Shop the post sheet; link_id's link on a post without products)

exclude.description: Words that keep this rule quiet, e.g. ["price", "refund"]: a comment mentioning one is left for another rule or a person

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

keywords.description: Words or emoji that trigger it, matched whole ignoring case and accents, plurals either way: "recipe" matches "Recipes please!" and "RÉCIPE", "link" doesn't match "linked"

link_id.description: A link from links_list that {link} stands for: its counted short link, so taps from answers show in Links. {products} falls back to it on a post without products

live.description: false pauses it (nothing is answered, nothing is lost); true turns it back on

match.description: keywords (default): comments that mention a keyword. any: every comment on post_id (needs post_id); a keyword rule on that post still answers first

mode.description: suggest (default): answers wait for one tap. auto: each goes a minute or two after the comment, spaced apart, up to 100 in any 24 hours per account; past that, answers go later as the 24 hours roll on. A comment with a link, spam, abuse or a complaint always waits for a tap. YouTube and TikTok are always suggest

post_id.description: Only comments on this post; omit for every post the account lists, however old (comments from the last 7 days)

reply.description: Public reply under the comment (Instagram up to 2,200 characters, Threads 500, Facebook 8,000, YouTube 10,000, TikTok 150); {name} becomes the commenter's username, {link} the rule's link (link_id), {products} the commented post's products (its Shop the post sheet; link_id's link on a post without products)

variants.description: Other wordings of the public reply. Each comment gets one of reply + variants (the same one if asked again), so a busy post's answers don't all read alike

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
